folios.title: The Grand Opening Manifesto & Marginal Index Key
folios.summary: Opens the manuscript with the famous gallows declaration fachys ykal ar ataiin, five left-margin index letters (y, s, d, o, a), and a centered boxed caption (dain os teody) at the bottom of paragraph 1.

clauses.eva: fachys ykal ar ataiin shol shory cthres y kor sholdy
clauses.english: Here begins the declaration (fachys) of the primary essence (ykal) from the first measured source (ar ataiin): the washed liquid extract (shol shory) is combined (cthres) with the core root-heart (y kor) and steeped in liquid (sholdy).

clauses.eva: sory ckhar or y kair chtaiin shar are cthar cthar dan
clauses.english: Draw (sory) from the heart-extract (ckhar) and oil essence (or) one infused measure (chtaiin) of the pure core (y kair), dividing the root-extract (cthar cthar) into the dose (dan).

clauses.eva: dain os teody
clauses.english: [Centered Boxed Caption]: Take this (dain) prepared star/seed essence compound (os teody).

folios.title: Deadly Nightshade (Atropa belladonna) Monograph
folios.summary: First painted plant in the book: shows paired dark-green ovate leaves, two dark spherical berries nested in star-shaped calyces, and a heavy split taproot.

clauses.eva: kchs ydaraishyol cthy dotoeesy ckhol chody
clauses.english: Begin with the core infusion (kchs) and root-shoot oil (ydaraishyol): steep the leaf (cthy) and boil the concentrated liquid (ckhol chody).

clauses.eva: chol daiin ctholyd darom
clauses.english: Take one measured dose (daiin) of the strained herbal liquid (chol), steep in the liquid medium (ctholyd), and complete the root preparation (darom).

folios.title: Wild Pansy / Heartsease (Viola tricolor) Cordial Monograph
folios.summary: Delicate violet-blue and red nodding blossoms on slender stalks with scalloped heart-shaped leaves and a red-tinted root crown. Rich in the kar/okar ('heart/core') stem.

clauses.eva: tydlo choly kykar ylchdoteol otol daiin
clauses.english: From the flower-liquid (tydlo), prepare the strained syrup (choly) of the heart-core (kykar), steep in the vessel (otol), and take one measure (daiin).

folios.title: Crimson-Blossom Centaury (poldchody Red-Blossom Guild)
folios.summary: Symmetrical branches crowned by crimson-red plumed flower tufts above palmate leaves. Opens with the rare headword poldchody, echoed on the final page f116v!

clauses.eva: poldchody ctheey chol daiin otol
clauses.english: Begin by steeping in the liquid vessel (poldchody): infuse the crimson blossom (ctheey) in one measure of strained herbal liquid (chol daiin) inside the vessel (otol).

folios.title: The #1 Cross-Referenced Herbal Hub (opchor Compound)
folios.summary: Palmate serrated leaves and a crimson terminal blossom above a claw-like rootstock. Shares the rare compound stem opchor directly with the Pharmaceutical jar on f89r1.

clauses.eva: koaiin opchor ofor otorol opchor daiin
clauses.english: Take the first measured portion (koaiin) of the vessel-infused compound (opchor), combine with the root-oil (otorol), and measure out one dose (opchor daiin).

folios.title: Climbing Sarsaparilla/Bryony Vine With Secret Top-Margin Note

clauses.eva: otaldary oparam otorGs kolkarabil
clauses.english: [Marginal Cross-Reference]: From the root-extract (otaldary), apply the final preparation (oparam) of the core root-mixture (kolkarabil).

clauses.eva: fshody daram ydaraishy otol dairo

clauses.english: Begin the flower infusion (pchor): take one measure of golden essence (or aiin) and one measure of washed liquid extract (shol daiin) in the strained calyx decoction (chol cthol).

visual_diagnostics: Down the left margin of f108v (p. 195) sit 16 painted stars: 7 Primary Recipe-Start Stars plus 9 Secondary Intra-Paragraph Step Stars (2 inside f108v.20–29 [119 words] and 7 inside f108v.30–53 [261 words])

Why did modern IVTFF transliterators merge f108v.30–53 (261 words), f111r.6–35 (365 words), and f111v.1–25 (294 words) into giant megaparagraphs? Because on the line immediately before each of the 54 Intra-Paragraph Step Stars across Quire 20, the scribe wrote all the way to the right margin (33.33% right-margin -m stop vs 8.40% at half-line breaks · a 3.97× surge!), leaving no blank half-line gap on the vellum!

The instant you split Quire 20's 285 paragraphs at those 54 Step Stars (285 + 54 = 339 Star Units), the standard deviation across Quire 20 collapses by 2.36× (33.14 → 14.02 words, CV = 0.867 → 0.436), and every megaparagraph converges onto the ~32-word canonical recipe length (33.2 on f111r, 29.4 on f111v, 32.6 on f108v, matching the 32.12-word global mean!)

specimens.plain_english_dossier: Look at Folio f108v (p. 195): 53 dense lines of recipes (581 words) with 16 painted stars down the left margin. In standard transliterations (ZL3b-n), f108v is listed as having only 7 paragraphs because lines 20–29 (119 words, 3 stars) and lines 30–53 (261 words, 8 stars) have no blank half-lines inside them. Why? We checked the end of the line right before all 54 Intra-Paragraph Step Stars across Quire 20 and found the smoking gun: on those 54 lines, the scribe finished the sub-recipe right at the far-right margin (33.33% right-margin -m stop vs 8.40% at half-line breaks = 3.97× surge!), so there was no empty space left on the line! Even better: when you divide the megaparagraphs by their painted stars (365 / 11 = 33.2 words on f111r, 294 / 10 = 29.4 words on f111v, 261 / 8 = 32.6 words on f108v), every single one collapses to the exact ~32.12-word average length of a normal Voynich recipe (2.36× reduction in standard deviation across the entire quire!).
specimens.confidence_tier: Tier A+ (Mathematical & Paleographic Proof of the 32.12-Word Star-Unit Invariant, 2.36× SD Collapse)
